catalogue.rule: Reserve for actual steps that change the shared test database schema or stored rows, including insertion, updates, deletion, migrations or snapshot restoration. Read-only database queries do not use this exclusive resource.

Reserve for actual steps that change shared proxy routes, DNS entries or load-balancer configuration. Merely sending traffic, observing routing or describing possible later changes does not use this exclusive resource.
Reserve for actual steps that change shared identity-provider clients, signing keys or role configuration. Merely logging in, validating a token or reading roles does not use this exclusive resource.

resources.quote: restore the saved snapshot into the shared test database, replacing its stored rows.
Then replace the shared reverse proxy route for /health with the new backend endpoint.
Keep identity-provider clients, signing keys and role configuration unchanged.
